note: Catalog only (D6601 / D6447). Black-box Go binary origin: evidence is the binary's own tables (go version -m, go tool nm symbols, route-like string literals) plus recorded HTTP traces. Never disassemble/decompile into WebIR, never invent handler logic, never claim D6448-ST from strings alone.

supported: Route method+path surface lifted from binary string literals matching the source peel
Handler names from go tool nm symbols (e.g. pkg.(*Server).ChatHandler)
Request/response shapes from recorded traces against the running binary

honestHoles.shape: Route-like string with no proven handler binding
Handler body (always, unless a recorded trace backs observed behaviour)
Stripped binary (-ldflags="-s -w"): no symbol table to bind handlers
